_about: Speaking has two parts. (a) Can-do self-assessment: rate each statement; level = highest level where the average is ≥ canDoThreshold and all lower levels also meet it (easily = 1, with effort = 0.5, not yet = 0). The same statements are used on every attempt so you can track change. (b) Speaking tasks: speak for up to maxSeconds. If the browser supports speech recognition, it writes down what it heard (editable); otherwise you can type a rough version or skip. Audio is never stored or uploaded by this app. The transcript, length and your self-ratings go into the results packet.

canDo.text: Introduce myself: name, where I'm from, what I do.
Order food or a drink at a taquería or café.
Ask how much something costs and understand the answer.
Say what I like and don't like.
Ask someone to repeat or speak more slowly.
Describe my daily routine and my family.
Make plans with a friend (day, time, place).
Tell what I did last weekend in a few sentences.
Ask for and follow simple directions in a town.
Handle a simple phone call (e.g. confirm a reservation).
Tell a story about something that happened to me, with details, in the past.
Keep a casual conversation going with friends or family for 10+ minutes.
Explain a problem and ask for a solution (landlord, store, doctor).
Give my opinion and briefly say why.
Follow most of a group conversation at a meetup when people speak clearly.
Argue for a point of view and respond to counter-arguments.
Talk about hypothetical situations (what I would do if…).
Keep up with native speakers talking at normal speed among themselves.
Rephrase when I don't know a word, without switching to English.
Adjust formality (tú/usted) and tone to the situation.

A.prompt: Describe a normal weekday for you, from morning to night.
A.hint: Me levanto a las… Después… Por la noche…

A.prompt: Tell about a memorable meal or celebration with family or friends. What happened?
A.hint: Hace unos años… Estábamos… De repente…

A.prompt: If you could live in any Spanish-speaking city for a year, which would it be and why? What would you do there?

B.prompt: Talk about your family or the people you live with.
B.hint: En mi casa vivimos… Mi… es…

B.prompt: Talk about {interests}: how you got into it and why you like it.
B.hint: Empecé a… cuando… Lo que más me gusta es…

B.prompt: Some people say phones are ruining conversation at family meals. Do you agree? Give your opinion and an example.
B.hint: Por un lado… Por otro lado… Yo creo que…
